name: im-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in the Isle of Man for 2026/27: 2006 Act companies (one director, a licensed registered agent), 1931 Act companies (two individual directors and a qualified secretary), limited liability companies under the 1996 Act, foundations, limited partnerships and foreign companies; Companies Registry incorporation fees (GBP 100 standard, GBP 250 two-hour, GBP 500 while you wait), annual return fees (GBP 380 standard, GBP 95 excepted) and late fees; the annual return within 1 month of its made-up date; beneficial ownership (nominated officer, 25% threshold from 2026, senior managing official); and the tax filings every company owes (online income tax return 12 months and 1 day after the period end, economic substance). Trigger phrases: set up a company in the Isle of Man, IOM company formation, 2006 Act company, Manx LLC, registered agent Isle of Man, annual return fee Isle of Man. For tax detail use im-corporate-income-tax, im-payroll-social and isle-of-man-v
